title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 177 ]

blocks.text: All parents agree that children must learn the difference between right and wrong. In order to teach this lesson, they sometimes punish their children. But ideas about how to punish children differ from culture to culture and family to family. Some parents believe that spanking children is the best way to punish. Others think that parents should never hit their children. Most parents punish their children in the same ways that they were punished by their parents. In short, there is a lot of disagreement about the best way to punish children.

readingSentences.english: All parents agree that children must learn the difference between right and wrong.
readingSentences.korean: 모든 부모들은 아이들이 옳고 그름의 차이를 배워야 한다는 데 동의한다.

readingSentences.english: In order to teach this lesson, they sometimes punish their children.
readingSentences.korean: 이 교훈을 가르치기 위해서 그들은 종종 아이들에게 벌을 준다.

readingSentences.english: But ideas about how to punish children differ from culture to culture and family to family.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 아이들에게 어떻게 벌을 주어야 하는가에 대해서는 문화마다, 그리고 가정마다 다르다.

readingSentences.english: Some parents believe that spanking children is the best way to punish.
readingSentences.korean: 어떤 부모들은 아이들을 체벌하는 것이 벌을 주는 가장 좋은 방법이라고 믿는다.

readingSentences.english: Others think that parents should never hit their children.
readingSentences.korean: 다른 사람들은 부모들이 자녀들을 결코 때려서는 안 된다고 생각한다.

readingSentences.english: Most parents punish their children in the same ways that they were punished by their parents.
readingSentences.korean: 대부분의 부모들은 그들이 그들의 부모에 의해 벌을 받은 것과 똑같은 방식으로 자신들의 자녀들에게 벌을 준다.

readingSentences.english: In short, there is a lot of disagreement about the best way to punish children.
readingSentences.korean: 간단히 말해서, 아이들에게 벌을 주는 가장 좋은 방법에 대해서는 상당한 불일치가 있다.
